purpose: Automatically synchronize Git metadata/source after every validated content milestone (for example a LOCKED lesson or stage checkpoint) so parallel chats do not resume from stale state. Large ZIP checkpoints remain in Library.
allowed_lightweight_automation: commit the affected workstream source/checkpoint after each validated milestone
update compact main PROJECT-STATE metadata when milestone identity changes
retry once on a concurrent fast-forward conflict
forbidden_or_default_off: blocking content production on GitHub Actions
sync_triggers: every stage PASS/checkpoint that becomes resume authority

coalescing_rule.rule: Do not intentionally skip validated user-facing content milestones. Sync the affected branch/checkpoint after each one.
coalescing_rule.binary_artifacts: Remain in Library/Project; Git records identities, hashes and source/metadata.

turn_budget.on_failure: Mark Git persistence PENDING and automatically retry before the next milestone in that workstream.

runtime_dependency_rule: Flashcards CURRENT may advance while Git mirror lags. Content integration targets CURRENT; Git lag never justifies fallback to LAST_FULLY_VERIFIED.
artifact_transport: Large ZIP/checkpoint artifacts stay in Library/Project/user-delivery; Git stores compact metadata/hashes/source.

target_semantics.scope: only the affected workstream/branch plus compact main coordination metadata
target_semantics.note: Do not wait for Hossein to request Git sync. Preserve workstream isolation so Menschen, Grammar, NVV, Lesen and runtime work do not overwrite one another.

non_triggers: every chat response with no validated milestone
